tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: The database connections this server knows, each with its name and the kind of database it speaks to (PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server). Pass a name as `connection` to the other tools.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: Databases on the PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server server a connection points at.

connection.description: A connection name from list_connections, or a postgres://, mysql:// or sqlserver:// URL (or a SQL Server connection string).

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: Schemas in a PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server database, system schemas left out. MySQL has no schemas apart from the database itself, so it answers that one.

connection.description: A connection name from list_connections, or a postgres://, mysql:// or sqlserver:// URL (or a SQL Server connection string).

database.description: A database on that server (see list_databases); defaults to the connection's own.

tools.name: import_schema
tools.description: Read the structure (not the data) of schemas in a live PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server database and return it as DBML. For large databases pass outputPath to write a file instead of returning the text.

connection.description: A connection name from list_connections, or a postgres://, mysql:// or sqlserver:// URL (or a SQL Server connection string).

database.description: A database on that server (see list_databases); defaults to the connection's own.

schemas.description: Schemas to import, e.g. ["public"] (PostgreSQL), ["shop"] (MySQL: the database) or ["dbo"] (SQL Server). See list_schemas.

outputPath.description: Write the result to this file inside the working folder and answer with a summary only.

tools.name: compare_with_database
tools.description: Compare a DBML model with one schema of a live PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server database: tables, columns, enums, references and indexes on either side only, or different.

text.description: The content itself. Give this or `path`, not both.

path.description: A file inside the server's working folder. Give this or `text`, not both.

connection.description: A connection name from list_connections, or a postgres://, mysql:// or sqlserver:// URL (or a SQL Server connection string).

database.description: A database on that server (see list_databases); defaults to the connection's own.

schema.description: The database schema to compare with. Defaults to public (PostgreSQL), the database itself (MySQL) or dbo (SQL Server).

tools.name: validate_dbml
tools.description: Check DBML with the DBML compiler: syntax, unknown tables and columns in references, duplicates. Errors come with line and column. Invalid DBML is a normal answer (valid: false), not a failure: read the errors and fix the text.

text.description: The content itself. Give this or `path`, not both.

path.description: A file inside the server's working folder. Give this or `text`, not both.

tools.name: dbml_to_sql
tools.description: Turn a DBML model into CREATE statements for one SQL dialect.

text.description: The content itself. Give this or `path`, not both.

path.description: A file inside the server's working folder. Give this or `text`, not both.

outputPath.description: Write the result to this file inside the working folder and answer with a summary only.

tools.name: sql_to_dbml
tools.description: Turn SQL CREATE statements of one dialect into a DBML model.

text.description: The content itself. Give this or `path`, not both.

path.description: A file inside the server's working folder. Give this or `text`, not both.

outputPath.description: Write the result to this file inside the working folder and answer with a summary only.
